up: Retrieve up to 200 metabolism records involving Cytochrome P450 3A4 or Cytochrome P450 3A5. Join the metabolism table with target_dictionary on enzyme_tid, filtering where target_dictionary.pref_name IN ('Cytochrome P450 3A4', 'Cytochrome P450 3A5'). Join compound_records on substrate_record_id to retrieve the compound name, and join compound_structures on molregno to obtain the substrate's canonical SMILES. Return the canonical SMILES, compound name, met_conversion, pathway_key, and organism columns. Limit the output to exactly 200 rows.
sql: SELECT cs.canonical_smiles, cr.compound_name, m.met_conversion, m.pathway_key, m.organism FROM metabolism m JOIN target_dictionary td ON m.enzyme_tid = td.tid JOIN compound_records cr ON m.substrate_record_id = cr.record_id JOIN compound_structures cs ON cr.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.pref_name IN ('Cytochrome P450 3A4', 'Cytochrome P450 3A5') LIMIT 200
